policy: Read-only snapshot; only observed results at least30secondsold; no API calls/runtime changes, no label values in diagnostic
interpretation_limits: Requests were not randomized with respect to provider availability over time; phase and content differences can be confounded by changing service conditions.
Each image was attempted once; no same-image crossover or successful retry was performed, so these data cannot prove or exclude image-specific incompatibility.
The exact error text reports image processing unavailable; it does not identify an unsupported image format or request-size limit.
All delivered images are corpus-validated full-frame RGB PNGs; original source format is not the uploaded format.
Small bins and incomplete rehearsal coverage should not be used to select a new image filter or alter labels.

excluded_request_details.note: Not an in-flight request at snapshot time; no replay performed.

delivered_png_mode_verification.scope: The same 1945 observed images in the unchanged snapshot; no later outcomes included. Verified file SHA256 against frozen manifest, then inspected PIL format, mode and dimensions.
